Size: Small
Complexity Drivers:
- 47 ports x 1764 lanes -> combinatorial explosion above 2209 route candidates.
- Network density 163.2% across 47 ports increases routing difficulty.
- Total demand 276,447 TEU requires capacity balancing across 0 services.
Demand Concentration: low - top-5 share 5.6% implies mixed hub and direct strategy.
Decomposition Rationale: ~15 ports per region enables scalable 3-agent optimization.

- Weekly profit $11,118,595 (24 services) -> $463,275/service/week.

- Transshipment $497,545 + port $10,121,960/wk.

Improvement Actions:
- Offer the unserved corridors to the next candidate pool.
- Re-balance vessel classes where utilisation is below target.
